summary: The note describes the Association of Christian Schools, Colleges and Universities (ACSCU) and its role as a founding member of the Coordinating Council of Private Educational Associations (COCOPEA). It states that ACSCU cooperates with four other COCOPEA member associations in the Philippines. The note is brief and does not describe ACSCU's membership, activities, or history beyond this.
one_line: ACSCU is a founding member of COCOPEA, cooperating with four other Philippine private education associations.
key_facts: ACSCU is a founding member of the Coordinating Council of Private Educational Associations (COCOPEA).
ACSCU cooperates with the COCOPEA member associations.
The Catholic Educational Association of the Philippines (CEAP) is a COCOPEA member association that ACSCU cooperates with.
The Philippine Association of Colleges and Universities (PACU) is a COCOPEA member association that ACSCU cooperates with.
The Philippine Association of Private Schools, Colleges and Universities (PAPSCU) is a COCOPEA member association that ACSCU cooperates with.
The Technical-Vocational Schools Association of the Philippines (TEVSAPHIL) is a COCOPEA member association that ACSCU cooperates with.
The note names four COCOPEA member associations that ACSCU cooperates with.
The note's source is listed as wikipedia.
The note does not state the year ACSCU was founded.
The note does not describe ACSCU's membership size or headquarters location.
